tasks.label: Fetch debug snapshots (simple)
args: $base='https://feature-smart-gate-preview.ef-map.pages.dev'; $u=$base+'/api/debug-snapshots?force=1'; $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $u -Headers @{Accept='application/json'}; if($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { $json = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; ($json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4) | Out-File -FilePath tmp_debug_snapshots.json -Encoding utf8; Get-Content tmp_debug_snapshots.json -TotalCount 80 } else { Write-Host ('HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode) }

tasks.label: Build frontend
args: cd eve-frontier-map; if (!(Test-Path node_modules)) { npm install }; npm run build
